clauses.clause: Desktop controls are **WASD + mouse** only (click-to-move removed). The heroine faces her walk direction and turns to the cursor only during click/hold + 0.45 s; melee/shot/rocket go toward the click point.
clauses.note: Fresh physical WASD/mouse matrix: bat, handgun, rocket × low/high, six cases and30 reviewed pose captures. Click-only displacement0m; no moveTarget in any sampled frame;24 actual attacks match input aim to vector error<=1.34e-15. At0.45s after release and through0.767s, resolved movement-facing error is0° in every case; prior71.1° late-facing defect no longer reproduces. Initial turn easing is retained in the raw trace, rather than mistaken for click steering. Labelled500×500 body crops of every capture were inspected at both qualities.
